messages:
jen: Quick note  starting a tiny refresh of the Hello Quickstart to use token auth and minimal deploy examples.

kevin: I'll update Docker + Cloud Run snippets. Runtimes? node:20 and python:3.11?

jen: Yes. Also rename env var everywhere: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN. Show export + .env.

ana: Can we add a one-line CLI to create demo tokens? small paragraph under Auth -> Migration would help.

kevin: Dockerfile for node quickstart I'll include: 
```
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```

jen: Add curl sanity check: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and a troubleshooting bullet for 401s.

ana: I'll open the PR and assign reviewers. Mark the token-creation CLI as demo-only.

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-5001--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 15m)

jen: Thanks  will review tonight and merge if no blockers.
